meta.source: Navy Hive (2026-10-16): the logo's navy hexagon colours the sidebar, the logo's X blue is the action colour, neutrals are tinted navy; see docs/design-system/xdev-hive/MASTER.md

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: First stop of the logo X gradient. Highlights in brand art (cover, empty-state art); never text.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the logo X gradient. Brand art and charts' first series; never body text.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Last stop of the logo X gradient. The brand's strongest blue for brand art; UI actions use `accent`.

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The logo's dark ground in both themes: app icon tile, desktop splash, the dark logo's background.

tokens.name: brand-letter
tokens.usage: HIVE / DEV HUB lettering colour of the logo. Matches `body` in light.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background (`bg-background`).

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Default text on `background`, `card`, `muted`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, popovers, inputs.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, select lists.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, selected indicators. The blue of the logo's X.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and chips.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Table headers, hovered rows, code blocks, read-only fields.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, metadata, timestamps.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selected rows and options, running state; info tint.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, delete and cancel actions.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and pills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Succeeded runs, online machines (the 'run green').

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success pills. Light is a step lighter than the Navy Hive draft (#E5F6EC) so `success` text on it reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Paused, needs review, budget warnings.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning pills.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls. Darker (light) and lighter (dark) than the Navy Hive draft (#8A97AE, #4A5D80) to keep 3:1 against `background` and `card`.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar background: the logo's navy in both themes.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Sidebar text and icons.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered sidebar items and the lighter navy chips (organisation, working folder).

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Strong sidebar text: product name, hovered and active items, the person's name.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item: `brand-blue` at 18% (light) and 16% (dark) over `sidebar`, flattened so contrast can be checked.

tokens.name: sidebar-active-icon
tokens.usage: Icon of the active sidebar item.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Count badges and the organisation mark in the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the sidebar; the hexagon of the logo on navy.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar (`ring` is too dark on navy in light theme).

tokens.name: sidebar-success
tokens.usage: `success` inside the sidebar: the light-theme greens, ambers and reds fall under 3:1 on navy, so the sidebar uses the dark-theme ones in both themes.

tokens.name: sidebar-warning
tokens.usage: `warning` inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-destructive
tokens.usage: `destructive` inside the sidebar.

groups.name: Scale
groups.note: Tailwind's type scale with xs raised to 13px and 2xs to 12px for Vietnamese diacritics; body text is text-sm (14px). Be Vietnam Pro (weights 400, 500, 600, 700; Vietnamese subset) for headings and text; the mono family is only for code, keys, ids, paths and logs.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Body text, table cells, buttons, inputs.

styles.name: text-stat
styles.usage: Key figures on stat cards; tabular numbers.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale with half steps; these are the steps the app uses.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge inside chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between stacked labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Sidebar item padding; input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page side gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top padding; gap before a new page section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; login card padding.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Base radius; shadcn derives sm (0.6x) to 4xl from it. Swiss style keeps corners small.

tokens.name: shadow-xs / shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards that float over the background; most cards use a border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and popovers.
